nom: The Crème Shop BT21 Brilliant Skin Hydrocolloid Acne Patches

segments.oily: One reviewer describes herself as oily and acne-prone and reports the patches work as well as Cosrx patches on her breakouts.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, super acne-prone skin reports the patches work well overnight and hold up when worn out during the day.

concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible reduction or clearing of individual pimples overnight or within a few days, including underground and cystic pimples; several dissenters (reviews 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7) report no visible change or no reduction in size at all.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with ongoing acne (including hormonal, adult-onset, and teen acne) report the patches extract gunk, reduce whiteheads, and speed healing over one to three nights; a minority found them purely cosmetic 'stickers' with no absorption effect.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers attribute reduced redness and inflammation to the zinc content, noticing calmer-looking skin around a blemish by morning; one reviewer found no effect on redness.
concerns.aging: One reviewer of unspecified age reports the patches help with dark spots left after breakouts, but this is not a widely discussed concern in the set.

aspects.libelle: No effect, feels like a sticker
Stays adhered overnight and during activity
Large patch sizes cover more area
Higher price due to BT21 branding
Leaves a shiny residue after wear

extraits.texte: I'm oily and acne-prone, so I'm always using pimple patches. These work just as well as the cosrx ones, just cuter because you have an alpaca on your face instead of a yellow circle.

i have super acne prone skin (combination) and i have tried lots of acne patches in the past, and these work so good. i was worried they wouldnt because theyre cute but i wear them to bed and in the morning theyre good to go! or i will wear out over a pesky spot and dont care because theyre cute too! definitley try these

extraits.titre: My sister and I LOVE these patches
extraits.texte: These patches are so cute and have a variety of sizes. My sister started wearing them first she is a young teen who gets spot acne. I'm an adult in my mid 20s and hormonal acne has been so annoying for me since I gave birth to my first child. These patches are awesome I feel like they really help my face and they're super cute. I would purchase more in the future. Great company.

I have tried about every brand of pimple patches, and nearly every variety (meaning what it's infused with). I can genuinely say that these particular ones with the zinc in them have won me over by far!!! They pull the most icky stuff out and they reduce inflammation the best. No lie, I only need to use these two consecutive nights and the pimple is completely gone. Even if you get impatient and pop one, clean off and put one of these bad boys on, it will be gone by morning! Love them

i've tried sooo many pimple patches.. (if you're here and need suggestions, plz, don't buy mighty patch, they suck.) these ones were pretty good. they worked better to reduce redness than to take gunk out of pimples.. i think the zinc in them is what helps reduce redness. also, the characters are so freakin cute. so definitely would buy again!

extraits.titre: just get the original hero patches
extraits.texte: I wanted to try these because they were cute and cheaper than the Hero Patches but unfortunately these patches did nothing for me. I used them the same way I would use the Hero Patches but after using them overnight I never saw that they reduced the size of my blemishes or collected any junk. What you're playing for is a pack of face stickers, don't expect them to actually do anything.

Absolute garbage. Doesn't work at all. Placed patch on blemish before going to bed and the following morning I removed the patch and my blemish was still there and nothing absorbed onto the patch. Only reason why I'm even giving it 1 star is because of the cute designs.
